# Critical Path

> Critical Path is an extensible, headless project management engine and framework for modern web applications.

Critical Path decouples project management logic from the presentation layer. It provides a core DAG/scheduling dependency resolution engine, universal Web Fetch route handlers, pluggable storage adapters (In-Memory, SQLite, Firestore), reactive UI primitives for React and Svelte, and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) and WebMCP tools for autonomous AI coding agents.

- Website: https://criticalpath.pixerate.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pixerate/Critical-Path
- Full Context: https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/llms-full.txt
- Sitemap: https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/sitemap.xml

## Start Here

- [Introduction to Critical Path](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/getting-started/introduction/): Learn why Critical Path was created, its headless philosophy, and how it transforms project management inside web applications.
- [Quick Start](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/getting-started/quick-start/): Get up and running with Critical Path in your project in less than 5 minutes.
- [System Architecture & Concepts](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/getting-started/architecture/): Detailed architectural breakdown of Critical Path layers, components, and data flow.

## Core Engine

- [Critical Path Engine](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/core/engine/): Working directly with the CriticalPathEngine class, core methods, and task management.
- [Data Model & Schema Reference](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/core/data-model/): Complete specification of tasks, projects, dependencies, priorities, and semantic statuses in Critical Path.
- [Dependencies & Critical Path Method](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/core/dependencies/): How Critical Path models task dependencies as a DAG, detects circular loops, and computes the critical path duration.
- [Lifecycle Hooks & Events](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/core/lifecycle/): Tap into mutation lifecycle events for validation, webhooks, audit trails, and side effects.
- [Ladder of Abstraction & CPM](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/core/ladder-of-abstraction/): Bret Victor's Ladder of Abstraction applied to timelines, Gantt charts, and Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis.

## Storage Adapters

- [In-Memory Storage Adapter](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/storage/in-memory/): Fast, zero-configuration in-memory store for unit tests, prototyping, and ephemeral workflows.
- [SQLite Storage Adapter](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/storage/sqlite/): High-performance embedded SQL storage powered by better-sqlite3 for local development and edge deployments.
- [Firebase & Cloud Firestore Storage Adapter](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/storage/firebase/): Scalable serverless NoSQL storage powered by Google Cloud Firestore.
- [Custom Storage Adapters](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/storage/custom/): Implement your own custom storage adapter for PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or Redis.

## Framework Adapters

- [Next.js App Router Integration](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/frameworks/nextjs/): Mount Critical Path route handlers directly in Next.js 14/15 App Router.
- [SvelteKit Endpoint Integration](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/frameworks/sveltekit/): Mount Critical Path route handlers in SvelteKit server endpoints.
- [Standard Web Handler](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/frameworks/web-handler/): Using the universal Web Fetch API router with Cloudflare Workers, Hono, Fastify, or Express.

## Frontend UI Libraries

- [React Integration (@critical-path/react)](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/ui/react/): Building reactive project management interfaces with React hooks and context.
- [Svelte Integration (@critical-path/svelte)](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/ui/svelte/): Idiomatic Svelte state primitives and runes for project management.

## Plugins & Extensibility

- [Plugin Architecture & Creation](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/plugins/creating-plugins/): Build modular plugins to extend the CriticalPathEngine with custom validation, webhooks, and integrations.
- [Audit Logging Plugin](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/plugins/audit-log/): Implement comprehensive audit logging for task status changes and assignee reallocations.

## Model Context Protocol (MCP)

- [MCP & WebMCP Overview](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/mcp/overview/): Dual Model Context Protocol architecture for AI coding agents and in-browser AI copilots in Critical Path.
- [Standard Server MCP](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/mcp/server/): Connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, and autonomous AI agents to Critical Path via stdio and network transports.
- [Client-Side WebMCP](https://criticalpath.pixerate.com/mcp/webmcp/): In-browser AI Copilots with W3C WebML CG WebMCP, React hooks, and Svelte 5 runes in Critical Path.

## Reference & AI
